character.name: Sloth
character.description: A cute sloth with sleepy half-lidded eyes and a gentle smile, actively climbing and firmly gripping a tree branch with all four limbs wrapped tightly around it, curved claws hooked securely over the top, alert and holding on confidently despite its sleepy face, shaggy brown-grey fur.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
